question_text: Describe the role of a controller in a greenhouse irrigation system that maintains target soil moisture.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves input/process/output reasoning but adds specified control-system context and feedback rather than unsupported generic embedded-device taxonomy.
solution: Reads the moisture sensor and target setting.; Compares measured moisture with target using its control algorithm.; Signals an actuator/valve to water when required and uses feedback to stop at the target.
